title: First GP Visit Starter Guide
author: BridgeWell Outreach Team
summary: A plain-language guide that helps newly arrived migrants prepare for a general practitioner visit, book interpreters, and understand common appointment steps.

title: Mental Wellbeing in Two Languages
author: Dr. Amira Noor
summary: This multilingual workshop pack explains stress, burnout, and anxiety in practical terms and suggests low-cost ways to seek help early.

title: Finding Local Counselling Options
author: Migrant Support Victoria
summary: A dynamic referral sheet listing counselling pathways, crisis contacts, and free community services for adults and young people.

title: Parent Wellness Circle Toolkit
author: Well Mothers Collective
summary: A facilitator kit for parent wellbeing circles covering sleep, isolation, school transitions, and culturally safe peer support conversations.

title: Healthy Work Rights Quick Guide
author: Community Legal Health Partnership
summary: An entry-level guide linking safe work practices, stress reduction, leave pathways, and where to get help when work harms health.

title: Community Nutrition on a Budget
author: Nadia Tran
summary: A practical resource with low-cost meal planning ideas, shopping tips, and community kitchen referrals for families under financial pressure.
